Question: How can strong local compositional disorder in high entropy oxides be exploited to generate tunable magnetic behaviors, ranging from macroscopically ordered states to frustration-driven dynamic spin interactions, and can a simplified model predict the emergence of these states?. System: La(Cr0.2Mn0.2Fe0.2Co0.2Ni0.2)O3 (L5BO) and Mn-varied variants La(Cr0.15Mn0.4Fe0.15Co0.15Ni0.15)O3 (40% Mn) and La(Cr0.1Mn0.6Fe0.1Co0.1Ni0.1)O3 (60% Mn). Processing: Pulsed laser epitaxy (PLD) on SrTiO3 (STO) and (La0.3Sr0.7)(Al0.65Ta0.35)O3 (LSAT) substrates; films were single-phase, epitaxial, with thicknesses of 56 nm (40% Mn), 58 nm (60% Mn), 62 nm (20% Mn), and ~90 nm for neutron diffraction..
